available_limit.description: The limit left to spend; null when the limit or the used part is unknown

credit_limit.description: The card limit as a decimal string; null when the limit is unknown

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount of the card

current_bill_close_date.description: The close date of the current fatura

current_bill_due_date.description: The due date of the current fatura

id.description: The credit account `id`, the same as in `GET /v1/spaces/{space_id}/accounts`

name.description: The name the user set, or the bank's account name

provider_name.description: The bank or institution name of a connected card; null for a manual card

used_limit.description: The part of the limit in use, as the Faturas page shows it; null when Visor has no bank data for the card yet

balance.description: Current value in `currency_code`, as a decimal string

category.description: The portfolio group Visor puts the investment in, such as `renda_fixa` or `fundos`

contributes_to_net_worth.description: False when the user left the investment out of net worth and of `summary.total_value`

provider_name.description: The institution that holds the investment; null when unknown

source.description: `connected` for a holding that syncs from Open Finance or B3; `manual` for one the user created

type.description: The investment type as the provider or the user set it, such as `CDB`, `ETF`, or `EQUITY`

updated_at.description: When Visor last changed the record, in ISO 8601 UTC

amount.description: Absolute amount as a decimal string, in `currency_code`. `type` gives the direction.

ignored.description: True when the transaction does not count in totals

source.description: `manual` for a transaction you recorded, `connected` for one that a bank sent, and `apple_pay` for one that the Apple Pay shortcut imported. Only `manual` accepts edits to every field.

type.description: `debit` for money out, `credit` for money in

active_space_id.description: The space the user has active in the app; null when the user has no space yet

display_currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency in which the app shows totals

name.description: The full name, or the email when the user has no name

plan.description: The effective plan: the highest of the own, sponsored, and granted plans

account_id.description: The card account of the plan; null when the plan has no linked account

first_due_date.description: The date of the first installment

installment_amount.description: The amount of one installment as a decimal string

next_due_date.description: The date of the next installment still to pay; null when none remains

paid_installments.description: The installments already paid (the `X` of `X de N`)

remaining_amount.description: The amount still to pay as a decimal string; `0` for a completed plan

status.description: `completed` when the user marked the plan as completed

total_amount.description: The amount of the whole purchase as a decimal string

total_installments.description: The number of installments (the `N` of `X de N`)

estimated_day_to_day.description: Day-to-day spending still expected, from the monthly budget. Zero without a budget.

projected_balance.description: current_balance + expected_income - committed_outflows - estimated_day_to_day, as the Projection page shows it. Goal contributions are not included.

amount_is_estimate.description: True while the bill cycle is open or the bank has not confirmed the closed bill

due_date.description: An overdue unpaid bill keeps its past date

request_id.description: The x-request-id response header of the request

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` to read the next page; null on the last page

amount.description: Manual transactions only. Positive decimal string.

notes.description: An empty string removes the notes

tag_ids.description: Replaces every tag. An empty list removes them.

body.description: The text the inbox shows, in the user's language

space_id.description: The space the notification is about; null for a notification about the whole account

title.description: The title the inbox shows, in the user's language

topic.description: A stable code for the kind of notification, such as `bill_reminder` or `weekly_summary`

currency_code.description: The display currency of the token's user, as an ISO 4217 code

total_value.description: Sum of the investments with `contributes_to_net_worth` true, converted to `currency_code` with the latest exchange rate

account_id.description: Account `id` that pays the expense; null when not tied to an account

amount.description: Expected amount of one charge as a positive decimal string.

frequency.description: How often the expense charges; null when Visor could not determine it

last_paid_date.description: Date of the last matched charge; null when none was matched

name.description: The name the user set, or the name Visor detected

next_due_date.description: Date of the next expected charge; null when unknown

service_name.description: Name of the known service (for example Netflix) Visor matched; null otherwise

account_ids.description: The visible accounts of this space that the connection feeds

last_successful_sync_at.description: When the connection last synced data successfully; null before the first sync

next_auto_sync_at.description: When Visor plans the next automatic sync; null when none is planned

paused.description: True when Visor stopped syncing the connection

requires_reauth.description: True when the user must reconnect the bank in the Visor app before it syncs again

status.description: The sync state of the connection. `login_error` and `outdated` usually need the user to reconnect the bank in the Visor app. `unknown` covers a state this API version does not name.

balance.description: Signed balance as a decimal string. A credit card balance is negative when money is owed.

hidden.description: True when the user hid the account in Visor

name.description: The name the user set, or the bank's account name

provider_name.description: The bank or institution name of a connected account; null for a manual account

source.description: `connected` for an account that syncs from a bank; `manual` for one the user created

hidden.description: True when the user hid the category in this space

key.description: Stable identifier of a system category, such as `category.food_and_drinks`; null for a custom category

kind.description: `system` for a category Visor provides; `custom` for one the user created

name.description: English name of a system category, or the name the user gave a custom category

type.description: Null for a system category that Visor created from a bank category and has not classified yet

account_id.description: An account of the space. Its currency is the transaction's.

amount.description: Positive decimal string with up to 2 decimal places. `type` gives the direction.

transacted_at.description: RFC 3339 date and time, with an offset such as `-03:00` or `Z`. A future time records a pending transaction.

amount_is_estimate.description: True when Visor rebuilt `total_amount` from synced transactions instead of reading the bank bill. An open cycle is partial until the bank closes it.

id.description: The bill `id`; null for a bill Visor projects before the bank sends it

minimum_payment.description: The minimum payment the bank reports; null when the bank does not report it

paid_amount.description: The payments Visor matched to the bill; null while `status` is `awaiting_bank_data`

status.description: `paid` when the bank or the user settled the bill; `closed` for a closed cycle; `open` and `due_soon` for the bank bill of the cycle still to pay; `current` for the cycle Visor rebuilds before the bank sends the bill; `awaiting_bank_data` when the bank has not sent the cycle yet

total_amount.description: The bill total as a decimal string; null while `status` is `awaiting_bank_data`

open_bills_total.description: Amount still to pay across the open card bills

period_end.description: Last day of the financial period

period_start.description: First day of the financial period

upcoming_bills.description: Bills due in the next 30 days, soonest first

default.description: True for the user's default personal space

role.description: The token user's role in the space

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` to read the next page; null on the last page

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code. Goals are always in BRL.

current_amount.description: The amount saved so far (initial amount plus contributions and allocations), as a decimal string

kind.description: `emergency_fund` is the reserve of the space; every other goal is `generic`

progress_percent.description: The progress shown in the app, rounded down and capped between 0 and 100

target_amount.description: The amount the goal aims to reach, as a decimal string

target_date.description: The deadline as `YYYY-MM-DD`; null when the goal has none (the emergency fund never has one)

personal_api_token.description: Personal API token created in Visor Settings

visor_cli_oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 access token of the Visor CLI browser login (authorization code with PKCE). Only the first-party Visor CLI client can use it on this API.

info.description: Personal REST API for Visor Premium users. Authenticate with a personal API token created in Visor Settings, sent as `Authorization: Bearer visor_pat_...`, or with an OAuth access token from the Visor CLI browser login.

get.description: Returns one page of the space's transactions, newest first (`transacted_at` descending, then `id`). Requires the `pfm:read` scope. Pass `next_cursor` as `after` to read the next page; it is `null` on the last page. Without `to_date`, the list ends today, so a future-dated transaction appears only when `to_date` includes its date.

parameters.description: First day to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in Brasília time
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: Last day to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in Brasília time. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: `true` for only ignored transactions, `false` for only counted ones. Omit it for both.
parameters.name: ignored

parameters.description: Text to find in the description, the merchant name, or the notes
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Transactions per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page. Omit it for the first page.
parameters.name: after

post.description: Records a manual transaction in an account of the space. Requires the `pfm:transactions:write` scope and an `Idempotency-Key` header. The transaction takes the currency of its account. A retry with the same key in the same account returns the transaction already recorded, with `idempotent-replayed: true`, and creates nothing; the same key with a different amount, type, description, date, or category returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

parameters.description: A value you choose for this create, 1 to 128 letters, digits, or `-` `_` `.` `:`. Send the same value when you retry. A UUID per create works well.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: The created transaction, or the one already recorded with the same key

idempotent-replayed.description: `true` when the response returns the transaction already recorded with the same Idempotency-Key

patch.description: Changes the fields in the body and keeps the others. Requires the `pfm:transactions:write` scope. A manual transaction accepts every field of the body schema. A connected or Apple Pay transaction accepts only `category_id`, `notes`, `ignored`, and `tag_ids`; any other field returns `409 IMMUTABLE_PROVIDER_FIELD`. `tag_ids` replaces every tag; an empty list removes them. The change is atomic: a failed validation changes nothing.
